Interface ResourceTypeAction

All Known Implementing Classes:
ResourceTypeActionJson
public interface ResourceTypeAction
The association between an action and a resource type, as returned by the IAM resource-type-action operations.

This is a read-only response view (spec schema ResourceTypeAction).
